full_title: MITHRA CANADA Peacock Choker Necklace with Pearl Drops | Gold-Tone Finish, Ruby & Emerald Stones, Adjustable Chain, Korean chain
bullets: TRADITIONAL PEACOCK DESIGN: Features an intricate peacock motif pendant inspired by classic South Asian jewellery craftsmanship.
VIBRANT GEMSTONE ACCENTS: Adorned with a striking pear-shaped ruby centrepiece, complemented by emerald and white stone detailing.
ELEGANT PEARL DROPS: Delicate faux pearl dangles hang gracefully from the ornate pendant, adding a refined and feminine touch.
GOLD-TONE FINISH: Crafted with a rich antique gold-tone finish that beautifully highlights the detailed filigree and scrollwork.
ADJUSTABLE CHAIN: Features a hook-and-eye clasp with an extender link, allowing for a comfortable and customisable fit.
description: Elevate your traditional look with this stunning Peacock Choker from MITHRA CANADA, inspired by the timeless artistry of Korean-influenced design. This exquisite necklace features an intricately crafted gold-toned pendant showcasing a majestic peacock motif, adorned with a vibrant teardrop-shaped ruby-red centrepiece surrounded by sparkling white stones and vivid emerald green accents. Lustrous cream-coloured pearl drops dangle gracefully from the pendant, adding an elegant finishing touch. The delicate gold chain is accented with small ball beads and features an adjustable hook-and-ring clasp for a comfortable, customisable fit. Perfect for weddings, festivals, and special occasions, this choker pairs beautifully with traditional ethnic wear such as sarees, lehengas, and salwar suits. It also makes a thoughtful and memorable gift for loved ones. The intricate detailing and rich colour palette make this piece a true statement of heritage and elegance.
